sub: Download music and videos from over a thousand sites, just by pasting the link.
urlsph: Paste one or more links here (one per line). Video, song or playlist, from any site.
qnote: Tip: many sites offer audio of around 128–160 kbps, so higher qualities may not improve the sound.
plm: Where to keep playlists and channels
plm1: In a folder named after the playlist (resumes if it exists)
plm2: In a new folder every time (name + date and time)
num: Number the files in playlist order
batch: When pasting several links, keep everything in a "Batch date-time" folder
split: Split into Music and Videos subfolders
nopl: Download only the video in the link (ignore the playlist)
plhint: Paste one or more links in the box on the left (single video, song or playlist). Everything shows up here: tick what you want and pick audio or video.
cur_note: Use your own image or one you have permission to use. It stays only on this computer.
dldir: Downloads folder (empty = the Downloads folder next to the program)
openm: How to open the program (applies the next time it opens)
openm_a: Own window (WebView2 built into the .exe; without it, Edge/Chrome in app mode)
meta: Put cover art and info (artist, title) in the file
safe: Careful mode: pauses between downloads to avoid being blocked
alt: If a video is blocked or removed, look for an alternative version
addid: Put the video ID in the file name
reset: Start over (ignore the history of what was already downloaded)
selfupd: Check for updates of the program itself when it opens (and ask before updating)
accnote: For private or age-restricted videos, or when a site asks you to sign in. The program borrows the login from your browser, trying one at a time in this order.
wait: If all fail, how many minutes to wait before trying again? (0 = stop)
cknote: If a cookies.txt sits next to the program, it is used first. Chrome-based browsers may need to be closed; Firefox is the most stable.
don_t: ☕ Buy me a coffee and help the developer stay up all night!
sup_p: It is free and was made with the help of Claude, an AI by Anthropic. If it helps you, your support keeps the updates coming and the project alive.
sup_star_s: Helps people find the project on GitHub.
sup_share_s: Tell a friend who also downloads media.
sup_bug_s: Something not working? Tell me and I will fix it.
sup_note: Supporting is entirely optional. The program stays free for everyone.
sup_pix_s: Scan the QR in your bank app or copy the Pix code. Any amount.
q_empty: Nothing queued. Paste a link and click Download.
frag_s: More connections = faster, but some sites may block it.
autoclip: Paste the copied link automatically when I open or return to the program
rs_msg: You have {n} download(s) that did not finish (the program closed or the PC shut down). Continue where it stopped?
chk_same: You already have the latest version ({c}).
chk_new: A new version is available: {v}! Use the banner at the top to update.
chk_err: Could not check right now (no internet or GitHub did not answer). Try again in a moment.
upd_msg: New version {v} available (you have {c}). Update now?
upd_restart: Updating… the program will reopen by itself in a moment.
updnote: yt-dlp, ffmpeg and deno are compared with the latest version every time the program opens (and every 6 hours while it stays open) and updated by themselves when there is a newer one. If a download fails because of an outdated extractor, yt-dlp is updated and the link is retried automatically. The button below forces a check now.
a_pick: Load a playlist and tick at least one track.
noff: Warning: ffmpeg is not installed (the download failed). Converting to MP3/MP4 may fail. Go to Settings > Update everything now to try again.
lib_empty: Nothing here yet. What you download shows up in this list and plays without leaving KoeDL.
lib_more: showing the first {a} of {b} — use the search to narrow it down
lib_err: This format does not play in here. Use "Open in the Windows player" or "Show in folder".
lib_pick: Pick a track from the list first.
lib_fail: Could not talk to the program. Try again.
lib_folders_s: Besides your download folders, add folders with music and videos you did not download with KoeDL.
lib_path: or paste the path, e.g. D:\Music
lib_f_pick: Choose the folder in the window that opened…
lib_f_nopick: Could not open the picker here. Paste the path in the field next to it.
